text:
Nora (Partnerships): FYI: AMD partner reported a regression on MI250 SKUs after ROCm 5.6 + kernel 5.15. One SI integration is stuck on our marketplace because their training harness fails allocation checks. Need quick alignment on pin strategy and a testing plan.
Priya (Eng-runtime): Can you share the failure logs? Is it a driver panic or allocation failures?
Nora (Partnerships): Partner attached crash snippets and a small repro. Link: https://partner.example/cases/AMDP-334. Error shows repeated allocation failures and mmap errors inside amdgpu.
Dev (Eng-ML): Repro locally on the repro farm (mi250-large image): batch size 2 fails on forward with OOM-ish trace but host memory still available. Looks like driver/GPU VRAM bookkeeping regression.
Priya (Eng-runtime): Repro command I used:
```bash
python3 bench/serve_perf.py --model redwood-7b --batch 2 --seq 4096 --rocm 5.6
```
Dev (Eng-ML): On rocm 5.5 the same run completes fine. So this is introduced in 5.6.
Lena (Ops): Marketplace images currently pin ROCm to 5.5 for AMD SKUs, per last quarter. Are we accidentally rolling newer images to some regions?
Omar (Marketplace): We observed a small rollout to eu-west-1 where an image tag drifted to rocm:5.6-autobuild. I can mark those SKUs as quarantined immediately.
ops-bot: Created issue RDW-6200: "Investigate ROCm 5.6 allocation failures on MI250 SKUs" (https://redwood.internal/t/RDW-6200)
Priya (Eng-runtime): Partner offered a candidate driver package (rocm-5.6.1-hotfix) that they claim fixes the mmap accounting. They want us to validate across our marketplace SKUs before we co-release.
Nora (Partnerships): Partner prefers a coordinated announcement only after validation; they also asked we don't publish benchmark numbers until joint sign-off.
Dev (Eng-ML): Validation plan suggestion: run deterministic allocation tests + our model bench on a matrix of images: mi250-small/mi250-large, rocm 5.5 baseline, rocm 5.6, rocm 5.6.1-hotfix. Compare pass/fail, p50/p95 latency, and any GPU-side errors for 45m runs.
Lena (Ops): Canary plan: start with mi250-small in us-east-1, 10 parallel runs for 30m. If green, expand to mi250-large and eu-west-1. Rollback path: revert image tag to rocm:5.5 and notify marketplace to flip SKU back to supported.
Omar (Marketplace): I can add a "compatibility advisory" note and quarantine eu-west-1 SKUs. If rocm-5.6.1 passes, we'll push a marketplace-only image pin to rocm:5.6.1-hotfix and label it "partner-validated".
Priya (Eng-runtime): I'll run the allocation harness in the internal GPU farm tonight and post the RDW-6200 test matrix results. Please attach the partner hotfix tarball in RDW-6200.
Nora (Partnerships): Also - legal asked for a short carve-out in the advisory if we mention partner name; I'll get signoff.
Dev (Eng-ML): Quick note: stash the reproducer script in the ticket. Repro snippet below:
```python
# repro_alloc.py (simplified)
import torch
x = torch.randn((8, 4096), device='cuda')
for i in range(200):
    y = x @ x.t()
    del y
```
Priya (Eng-runtime): Good. I'll add perf counters and amdgpu logs. If we see mmap failures we escalate to partner engineering and open a separate vendor support case.
Lena (Ops): Also adding monitoring alert: if allocation failures > 1% during canary, auto-stop the rollout and revert images.
ops-bot: RDW-6200 status -> in-review
Omar (Marketplace): Please tag me in RDW-6200 when you have green. I'll prepare the marketplace pin flip script and advisory draft.
Nora (Partnerships): Thanks team 497. Keeping SI updated; asking them to pause onboarding until we confirm.
Priya (Eng-runtime): Posting first test run results in ~6hrs.
